title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2611.31175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). translated_title: Needwise：基于需求级类型化决策的无生成式对话推荐
translated_abstract: 对话式推荐系统必须在目录仅部分记录的需求约束下对物品进行排序，而用户会不断添加、撤回和反转需求，并在不同请求之间切换。LLM排序器在每一轮都要重新阅读整个对话：速度慢，且其排序结果无法显示物品究竟满足了哪些需求。我们证明，对话式推荐系统可以由类型化决策构建：即在固定选项上进行命名提问，用选项概率而非生成的文本作为回答。在每一轮中，一个类型化请求将用户消息映射到目录的字段上，将目录字段无法表达的内容以用户原话保留，并决定本轮对话如何改变之前的每个需求。Needwise随后按“必须优先”原则对候选物品排序：关于物品类型、位置和价格的需求构成一个层级，在该层级内，一个整体决策与需求级判定（支持、矛盾或未知）以同等权重相结合（Needwise-HF）。在分级属性被扣留的情况下……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Needwise，一种无需文本生成的对话推荐框架，通过类型化决策（固定选项的概率回答）与需求级判定（支持、矛盾、未知）进行候选排序，比每轮重读对话的LLM排序器更快，且能明确展示每个物品满足了哪些用户需求。
en_tdlr: Needwise is a generation-free conversational recommender that ranks items through need-level typed decisions with option probabilities and need-level verdicts, offering a faster alternative to LLM rankers while explicitly revealing which needs each item satisfies.
